@: The audio track panel (web/js/mixer.js), styled like the DaVinci Resolve mixer: A0 Master, then one lane per OBS audio track (A1, A2, ...) with mute (M), solo (S), a fader in dB and a level meter. DIM lowers what you hear without changing the mix. A "stem" is one OBS track rendered as its own audio file. dB, dBFS, L / R are units / channel names.
master.name: Master
@master.dim_btn: Short button label, as in Resolve; keep it very short.
@master.dim_title: {db} is a positive number; {steps} is a list such as "10 / 15 / 20 / 30". The text has two lines.
master.dim_title:
DIM: listen {db} dB quieter without changing the mix (monitoring only, like Resolve)
right-click: change the amount ({steps} dB)
@master.db_dim: The master level next to the DIM amount, e.g. "+1.5  DIM -15".
master.meters_title: master peak level, L / R (before DIM) - click: reset the peak hold
master.wave_title: the mix as set above (estimated from the track peaks) - red = over 0 dBFS. click: seek
@fader.title: {what} is fader.master or fader.track.
fader.title: {what} (dB): drag, mouse wheel 0.5 dB (Shift 0.1 dB), double-click: 0 dB, bottom stop: -inf
lane.solo_title: solo (Ctrl / Shift + click: solo only this one)
lane.load_failed: this track could not be loaded
@lane.tip: Tooltip of the track number. {n} is the OBS track number, {name} its OBS name, {role} a role text (role.*). Further lines follow it (lane.tip_*).
lane.tip_lifted: lifted like in the clip mix
state.no_tracks: no playable tracks (playing the clip's own mix)
state.suspended: click anywhere to enable the track mix (playing the clip's own mix)
state.loading_fallback: loading tracks... (playing the clip's own mix)
det.summary_sub: OBS names, roles, clip mix, peaks
det.note: Default mix = the clip mix: game + mic + squad on; desktop, music and silent tracks muted. Mute wins over solo.
